title: Entity details
responsibility: Chooses contract summary, measurements or source within entity details.

inputs.name: EntityDetails.entity
inputs.description: Required entity supplying the accessible name and unit passed to source/measurement panels.

inputs.name: EntityDetails.contract
inputs.description: Required prepared contract rows passed to the default summary view.

inputs.name: EntityDetails.measure
inputs.description: Required prepared entity measure passed to the default summary view.

inputs.name: EntityDetails.record
inputs.description: Required verification record or null, used only by the measurements panel.

inputs.name: EntityDetails.tab
inputs.description: Optional. Defaults to JavaScript undefined and shows the contract with its measurement summary. source selects source files; measurements selects measured detail; summary selects only the performance summary.

inputs.name: EntityDetails.repository
inputs.description: Optional. Defaults to JavaScript undefined. Source files then remain plain paths without GitHub links.

inputs.name: EntityDetails.commit
inputs.description: Full commit hash of the viewed entity.

inputs.name: EntityDetails.nav
inputs.description: Optional. Defaults to JavaScript undefined. Without revision-scoped navigation, the Source tab omits code-opening actions.

outputs.name: EntityDetails
outputs.description: Renders source files, measured detail, the standalone performance summary, or the default contract with its summary. On phones, measurement fields stack with visible labels and whole-word values.

errors.name: Source navigation callback error
errors.description: On the Source tab, an error from nav.source propagates when a file code action is activated; other tabs do not invoke it.
